meta.source: Mete Blueprint V2 Claude Design Spec (Oct 17, 2026), section 2

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Warm white page background (spec: warm white backgrounds).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables and form fields on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table headers, inset wells.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Slate body text on bg and surface (13:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Helper text, captions, timestamps, field explanations (5.9:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, card outlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy (spec #1B2A4E). Primary buttons, active nav, links, focus rings, report headings. In dark theme it lightens so it reads on the dark ground.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a navy fill (14:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: navy-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active tab ground, info callouts; navy text on it passes AA.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass gold (spec #C9A227). Fills only: the Generate Blueprint action, highlights, progress bars, the report cover rule. Navy text on brass is 5.8:1. Never brass text on a light ground.

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass as text: eyebrows, top-three action markers, assumption flags (5.4:1 on bg).

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the Needs Review chip and assumption highlights.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Ready / Verified / positive cash. Always with a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for Ready and Verified chips.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Estimated values, capacity warnings, Unverified items.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning chips and capacity alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical risks, negative cash balance, blocking review items.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for critical chips and error states.

families.serif: "IBM Plex Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Report cover and screen titles on large screens.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Screen titles and report section titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Expected monthly orders feed capacity, labor and cash.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels, table headers, status chips.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: KPI numbers; set with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-field gap; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen padding on desktop; space above section titles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the report page sheet.
